_about: Public-domain William Jay (1769-1853, Independent minister of Argyle Chapel, Bath) for the Word Hoard: the Works (New York: Harper, 1861, 3 vols, 'comprising matter not heretofore presented to the American public') and his Autobiography (London: Hamilton, Adams, 1855, ed. George Redford and John Angell James), raw Internet Archive OCR from Trinity College, Toronto and Princeton scans. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 6 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
